answer: Each identity files one DNA-verified lotus seed accession from the harbor wetland with the seed vault. The vault sequences it, publishes its hash, and runs a 180-day germination test; weight unlocks only once it sprouts, and duplicates fail DNA match. Per fake: 800 units plus 180 days no money can shorten; the vault tests viability. One accession backs exactly one identity. For 100 fakes: 80,000 units and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat: buying a ready accession for about 2,000 units, but the seller gives up the accession anchoring their own identity, and a bribed technician fails the re-test.
